en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Faith and Customs Culture Festival runs through next Sunday
en.dek: The fifth edition of the festival at Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple opened today under the theme of inheritance and crossing, with free workshops, talks and guided tours until 15 November.
body: Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple is hosting the fifth Wong Tai Sin Faith and Customs Culture Festival from today until 15 November. The event marks the temple’s 105th anniversary and follows the listing of Wong Tai Sin beliefs and customs as a national intangible cultural heritage in 2014.

Organisers said the programme includes cultural talks at the Fung Ming Lau Hall, hands-on workshops such as colouring historical black-and-white photographs and making miniature fire-dragon crafts, and free on-site experiences including badge making and prayer bamboo tubes. Full-temple guided tours are also available on selected days, with advance registration required for talks, workshops and tours.

The festival is free to enter. Visitors can find the temple at 2 Chuk Yuen Village, Wong Tai Sin. The organisers said the activities aim to let participants experience traditional crafts and learn about the transmission of the beliefs alongside contemporary topics.
Further details and registration information are available through the temple’s public channels.

zh.headline: 第五屆黃大仙信俗文化節今日開幕 至15日舉行
zh.dek: 嗇色園黃大仙祠舉辦第五屆信俗文化節，主題「傳承與穿越：承『仙』啟後」，設講座、工作坊及導賞，免費入場至11月15日。
body: 嗇色園黃大仙祠由今日起至11月15日舉辦第五屆黃大仙信俗文化節。活動適逢嗇色園創園105周年，黃大仙信俗亦於2014年列入國家級非物質文化遺產名錄。
主辦方表示，節目包括鳳鳴樓禮堂的文化講座、黑白照片上色及迷你火龍紮作等體驗工作坊，以及現場免費製作襟章、祈願竹筒等活動。部分日子設全園導賞，講座、工作坊及導賞需預先報名。
文化節免費入場。黃大仙祠位於九龍黃大仙竹園村二號。主辦方指，活動旨在讓市民體驗傳統工藝，並認識信俗傳承與當代課題。
詳情及報名可透過祠堂公開渠道查詢。
